Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the Planner incorrectly inferred that the maternal grandfather is Abraham B. Friedman. The WebSurfer search results in Step 3 clearly identified Margo Howard's father as Jules Lederer (also spelled Julius Lederer). The Planner ignored this direct evidence and instead confused the maternal lineage with the maternal grandmother's (Ann Landers) maiden name (Friedman), incorrectly assuming Ann Landers was the daughter of Abraham B. Friedman (which is false; Ann Landers was the daughter of Jules Lederer). This led to the generation of the wrong final answer.
